guidance.purpose: Register thumbnails, diagrams, notebook scans, podcast art, document covers, generated illustrations, portraits, and external-news visuals used by the public site.
principles: Do not silently present generated illustration as documentary imagery.
Do not force diagrams or notebook pages into destructive crops merely for visual uniformity.
Record alt text and intended role when an asset is admitted to the site.
Nathan-supplied thumbnails and visuals can be added incrementally as they arrive.

asset_schema.source_path_or_url: repository path or stable source URL
asset_schema.title: short display title
asset_schema.caption: site caption
asset_schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD or historical period when known
asset_schema.focal_point: optional x/y or prose crop note
